text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to make everyone smile with my races!
Just like a good chanko nabe♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's all have hot pot together!
Packed with ingredients and full of nutrition! How buono♪

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
